liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodleoo** (3 reviews): Half-Step is slow to get going in this audience-source review, though the rest of set one is strong; The Half-Step into Franklin's opener only picks up near the end of Franklin's Tower [14][16][24]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Tennessee Jed is singled out as tremendous [24]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Lazy Lightning into Supplication is the reviewer's first-set highlight, with Phil's manic, driving bass line [17]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): Reviewer praises the second-set Miracle into Bertha [21]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the second-set Bertha as unbelievable [16]
- **Saint Of Circumstance** (1 review): The jam coming out of Saint of Circumstance into Drums is a highlight [24]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Stella Blue is called mistimed and disjointed, a sloppy moment [22]

## The recordings

- **gd79-11-02.sbd.macdonald.7920.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 164 min; rated 4.33/5 by 21 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is above average at its best [22]
- **gd1979-11-02.fob.nak700.glassberg.MOTB-0077.94221.flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1979-11-02.152533.mtx.photoleon.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 170 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1979-11-02.164279.aud.CD320.ohr.flac1644**: audience recording; 18 songs; 165 min [7]

## Around the show

- Healy roped off an official tapers section in front of the board, giving Barry Glassberg control of it; he invited friends [3]
- Bill shouted an obscenity at the audience before the encore [5]
- Bill shouted an obscenity at the audience before the encore [7]
- Attendee places this among the best second sets seen, on a tour including two Cape Cod shows and three Nassau shows [21]
- Reviewer thinks at least ten to fifteen other 1979 shows are better than this one [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd79-11-02.sbd.macdonald.7920.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Transfer comes from a cassette master; no reel-to-reel recordings were made on this tour; Soundboard to master reel, then Dick's cassette, then DAT, then CD, via Alasdair Macdonald [1][13]
- **gd1979-11-02.fob.nak700.glassberg.MOTB-0077.94221.flac24**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Adam Egert and Brian Green; source: 2 x Nakamichi CM-700's => Sony TCD5 >> 37th Row Center on the Pole >> MAC Analog Audience Source: Just in front of SBD (MAC) Media: 2 x Maxell UD-XLII 90 min [3]. Also: Second tape had left-channel flaws recurring every couple seconds; they were corrected in WaveLab, leaving minor artifacts. Tape flips were crossfaded [3]
- **gd1979-11-02.152533.mtx.photoleon.flac1644**: source: Matrix created in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel May 04, 2021 [5]. Also: Barry Glassberg recorded it; Rob Eaton supplied the soundboard DAT source, transferred by Charlie Miller; MOTB crew did the transfer [5]
- **gd1979-11-02.164279.aud.CD320.ohr.flac1644**: taped by Ohr Weinberg; transferred by Anne Cohen; source: Master Audience Cassettes - recorded by Ohr Weinberg: 2 Cardiod Microphones (don't remember which ones) > Marantz Superscope CD-320 (no NR, Set 1 & 2 - Maxell… [7]. Also: Set one tape flip at 31:55 between Franklin's and El Paso; set two flips after the Saint jam and during Sugar Magnolia [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-11-01 Nassau Coliseum, Uniondale, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-11-01-nassau-coliseum-uniondale-ny-usa/) [26]
